# Photo fixtures

From scikit-image's sample data, downscaled to 512 px.

- `IMG_0001.jpg`: Cat. CC0 by the photographer (Stefan van der Walt).
- `IMG_0002.jpg`: Cup of coffee. CC0 by the photographer (Rachel Michetti).
- `IMG_0003.jpg`: SpaceX launch. Released into the public domain by SpaceX.
- `IMG_0004.jpg`: Hubble deep field. NASA, public domain.
- `IMG_0005.jpg`: Greek coins, Brooklyn Museum. No known copyright restrictions.
- `IMG_0006.jpg`: Horse silhouette, openclipart. CC0 (Andreas Preuss).
- `IMG_0007.jpg`: Motion-blurred wall clock. Public domain (Stefan van der Walt).
- `IMG_0008.jpg`: Brick wall texture, CC0Textures. CC0.
- `IMG_0009.jpg`: Fundus photograph of a retina, Wikimedia. CC0 (Mikael Häggström).
- `IMG_0010.jpg`: Astronaut Eileen Collins, NASA. Public domain.
